provenance.what: a real exchange with IBM Watson Text to Speech, recorded by scripts/record_tts_golden.py
provenance.response_body_is: the first 128 bytes of the response, which is the RIFF header and the start of the audio
provenance.response_is_not: the whole response. app/tts.py returns the bytes the service sent without examining them, so what a replay asserts is that it returns exactly what it was handed, and the audio itself would add nothing a test could check
provenance.holds_no_credential: the host is not in the request, because TTS_URL carries an instance id, and the Authorization header is redacted because the real one is built inside send and never leaves it
